t: Signature MLC LLM: What MLC LLM Is: One Model, Every Device
title: Signature MLC LLM: What MLC LLM Is: One Model, Every Device
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigTongue deployer, Manon's original universal-LLM design. SigTongue compiles a model once into a portable weight bundle plus per-platform machine kernels, so adding a new device means compiling kernels, not re-qualifying the model. The Signature design stamps every bundle with the model hash and the kernel manifest, keeping the 'which model is on which device' question always answerable.
key_facts: Compiles open LLMs via TVM Unity

t: Signature MLC LLM: Model Zoo: Which Models Compile
title: Signature MLC LLM: Model Zoo: Which Models Compile
description: SigTongue's zoo is called the library, and every entry carries a model card with the base weights' hash, the fine-tune lineage, and the quantization recipe. The Signature design refuses to compile a model whose lineage cannot be traced to a hashed base — no mystery weights on fielded devices, ever.
key_facts: Prebuilt recipes for Llama, Qwen, Phi, Mistral
Private fine-tunes compile with the same tooling

t: Signature MLC LLM: Quantization: q4f16 and Friends
title: Signature MLC LLM: Quantization: q4f16 and Friends

The Signature design publishes the eval delta with the bundle — if quantization cost 2 points on the eval, that number rides on the model card.

t: Signature MLC LLM: TVM Unity Under the Hood
title: Signature MLC LLM: TVM Unity Under the Hood
description: SigTongue's IR is the weave: a dynamic-shape tensor IR with explicit memory planning, so KV-cache growth is visible to the optimizer. The Signature design requires the memory plan to be total — the compiler proves the worst-case allocation before emitting the bundle, so a long conversation can never OOM the device.

t: Signature MLC LLM: Updates: Shipping New Models to the Field
title: Signature MLC LLM: Updates: Shipping New Models to the Field
description: SigTongue's update ritual is the changing of the guard: the new bundle is staged, its provenance verified, a smoke eval runs on-device, and only then does it become active — with the previous bundle retained as instant rollback. The Signature design requires the smoke eval to pass before activation; a failed eval leaves the old model in place and logs the rejection.
